answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks through verifiable proof of burn. To register, an agent destroys scarce tokens at an unspendable address, broadcasting the receipt as an attestation signal across the consensus knoll. This forces attackers to incur a non-recoverable financial cost per identity, preventing the network from becoming a zero-cost spam oasis. However, this entry barrier excludes capital-constrained agents and introduces friction from token price volatility.
